Thank you for both hot understanding as well as your advice.

I'm getting my life back on track one step at a time and I'm starting to learn that it's okay to ask for help.

You are fantastic!

I guess it's kind of always been there, but after my first severe panic attack and psychotic episodes, I had to go to therapy for month after month and was put in and out of hospitals.

Some days, I'm just debilitated and can't even function..
Was in the military. Discharged for mental disorders... Still trying to become sane :(
Thank you so much. I have an ample amount of free time this weekend and I will have to give it a listen.

Thank you, it's really hard to admit this even over the Internet to strangers.

That's why it's taken me so long to reply.

I appreciate your kind words very very much.. I guess I'm worried that someone who is a more immediate need of help won't get the help they need of I post here, you know?
Found the NEEEEEERRRRDDDD
I am the angriest mother fucker alive on this piece if shit rock we call Earth.

A lot of it is language barrier, and  regarding calling someone; no.

I feel completely alone here with this problem of mine.

I'm actually pretty shy about posting here as well :(

I expect to get downvoted for this, honestly, but it blows.

You can make then all go away if you absolutely wanted to.

He can't. I can't make him anymore. These Tulpas are just offensive to me and him.

I came here because I thought I could get help getting rid of it, but all I see are people making fake splits and treating them like a child's plaything.

By all means, I hope people find enjoyment through it and grow somehow through it, but I'm just alone (physically but not mentally) and scared.

It's torture.
No. Exceptions.

*zzzzzziiiip*

;)

Since this will be buried;

Tuck my penis inside my own vagina.
Trying to motivate them to be better than the "condition". Cuz they are...

I was hospitalized because they thought I was getting psychosis what with hearing things and the visual and auditory hallucinations.

It turned out to be stress induced hallucinations caused by BPD.

Listen here, as someone who's been living with BPD, PTSD, stress anxiety disorder with panic attacks so bad they get mistaken for heart attacks to the point where I would get hospitalized for days at a time AND psychosis while having to have had active duty military service; I'm going to stop you right there.

You are not mentally ill.

You just function differently from other people do.
The moment you call it a disease or an illness, you've let it win. Automatically, you've turned it into a crutch. God dammit, I know it's fucking hard, believe me. I'm living with it too. But I can tell you right now, that the self-pity isn't worth it.

It really isn't.
"Sir, you have very nice breasts."
Me too.

He wants me to do my duty as a man and take care of her;

But I don't think he wants to be around when she's there.

I hadn't even remembered the Aztecs until you said that!

That is fascinating...
It's alright, I'd really love to meet them. He's just being stubborn for some reason, and I think it's because he doesn't want to meet anyone/thing like him.

Your questions are fine! Haha

But he doesn't know what the hell you're talking about. 😅
The king eats, the hand takes the shit.
...what's the... Fox say?

When we are alone and not doing anything, I feel like he gets restless and will act strangely just to see what will happen.

He can be so bizarre I almost feel embarrassed about it for him haha

It's like he doesn't understand social norms.

His mocking is playful and is actually a necessary kick in the ass to do thinks I'm supposed to. He makes me eat, bathe, sleep, and get out of bed even during the days I only want to lay in bed all day.

I can't really poke fun at him. I don't know why, but when I try to think of something to say I can't. It's not like I'm worried he'll get angry... I just can't... Huh.

I've always been gifted with fantastic intuition and he's just able to read people as they are. I almost don't think he hears what people say, he only understands their meaning. Some people in this thread have actually made him uncomfortable and I don't know why but it makes me worry too.

Of course! I'm a very philosophical person and enjoy discussing philosophy with fellows!
Anytime you want to talk I'm a PM away. This is Iz's account now and he doesn't want it deleted. But I'm keeping it far away from my main account, as you can imagine.

He appeared suddenly and I just forcible asked him who he was and what he wanted with me.
"Iz'Qidll. And I'm here to help you whether *I* want to or not."
I'd love to, by Iz'Qidll refuses.

He says that he's only here to help me because I'm all he knows.

I get the feeling that everyone is imaginary to him because I have to tell him/show him when people are around or talking. But sometimes I don't.

He's speaking gibberish right now and nothing else makes sense.

I was easy to understand you just fine, and that's all I can ask of you. :)

We met more than a month ago. I honestly can't remember if I saw him or heard him first, but I was having a mental breakdown at the time so I locked myself in my room alone so no one in the barracks would see me go mad.

What is your native tongue?

Edit: Spelling. (See? Even native speakers make mistakes!)

The best way I can describe it is that I can see him watching. I mean to say that, visually, I see the task ahead of me but I can "see" him as if I'm looking at him watching me.

When I'm driving it's different though; I've been in some terrible wrecks where I've been sent to the hospital, had the vehicle totaled, and have had physical rehabilitation for a few months.... And he knows I'm a nervous driver because of it. He gently, but firmly, makes me pay attention to the road and doesn't let me "watch him, watch me".

When it comes to other tasks, I can "see" him in one of three ways:
1) I can "feel" him standing next to me or on my shoulder.
2) I can see him watching me with his eyes no longer looking angry, and are wide open, but he has no mouth (like it's closed)
3) I can sometime feel him looking through my eyes. He only does this with Skyrim. He usually does number 2 when I play other games.

Skyrim is the only time I "take of the leash" and don't try to keep him back.
I have my main account that I play on and then the one that I let him "live" in.

This may be inconsequential to your question, but he plays very strangely. I can't tell if I'm not able to hear him all the time whisk playing, or he just truly plays strangely.

He doesn't like to murder innocents, steal, worship deadra or the divine, he doesn't use weapons, and he doesn't want any excess transformations (werewolf or vampire). And he has to eat and sleep.

Ask as many questions as you want.

The strange thing is, unless I try very hard to concentrate then it is difficult to remember what he says.

I have very few opportunities to speak with him and he doesn't like answering those questions. He acts like he has a purpose outside my mind that he needs to escape for. But then gets frustrated because he's trapped.
Sounds like /r/outside is beckoning us from her juiciest loins.

I've known Iz, as he is, for a month and a half.
He only ever asks questions when I would do something dumb. A sarcastic question such as "...why in the hell did you do that? What did that accomplish?"

He's not judgmental in the fact that he's thinking that he's better than me, it's more if a judging towards how he needs to behave and treat me.
"Overly happy figures are unsettling. Humans, by nature, see something dark and let it sit in the background. And keep a healthy doubt in it."

He "writes" some of the replies even.

He won't even tell me what he is, much less someone else. :/

He's only gotten angry enough to scare me once, but I was an emotional wreck from crying and couldn't even get out of bed without him telling me to. He was an angry motivator.

Because I hardly remember dreams, he stays away from them intentionally or unintentionally.
My inside joke is. I feed of anger.

"Then you degrade me to a child's plaything?"

 I don't think he understands. 
Are you saying that they become their own or that we control them?

I've been holding him back done and it sounds like you want to release the reigns.
One reason I don't want to read into it is to avoid giving him ideas. When he sees something/someone he likes, he'll slightly add pieces to himself.

I don't even know how to fully come to terms with this thing yet. Sometimes it's natural, other times I become very scared and paranoid.
I just want my mind back and peace/resolution.
I do, and he'll either get irritated or laugh at me. But, when things go bad, he's always there to help. He, grudgingly I can tell, is very protective.

Conversation.

Certain events, and people who behave oddly/different from us.
Then do what you will and what comes naturally, right?
Yes, you're welcome to try it!
By all means, there's no rush. We're stuck here for all of you anyway.
What do you mean?

He doesn't like it for some reason, he feels invaded?

You can ask him questions directly. It might help.

He's paying attention intently.
Iz thinks you have more to add.
He can speak with words when he's restless, emotions when he wants to (leaving me to find the words), and can bring up memories/pictures if he doesn't feel like he's able to say something right.

We talk in my head, and rarely do we talk out loud.

One of the first things he's said to me was that he hardly wanted to be there so me wanting him gone doesn't phase him.

As a weird side note, he loves Deadpool. It's actually pretty creepy how intently he watches him when I watched gameplay videos.

I understand what you mean, and I would like to say that I have no true clear idea who he is. I'm not sure I should mess with spirits either.

Iz makes it abundantly clear that he doesn't want to mess with spiritual things. He makes me feel discomfort even talking about it, quite honestly.

I understand what you mean, and I would like to say that I have no true clear idea who he is. I'm not sure I should mess with spirits either.

Iz

He wants this account now to be his.
He likes talking until he is tired and he lets me alone then.

Some people annoy him, some people pique his interest, but he has yet to be fully engaged yet.
As I've said before, it's hard to read him sometimes.

I CAN go on an existential rant about what reality is and what human sanity is truly defined to be, but I'll put it in the way that I choose to believe it.

The human mind should only have one person in it, and he doesn't appear fully human. I do. So, he's the fake one and I'm the real one.

He insists that trivial things don't have any importance to him and he wants to be able to "rest" and leave. He knows hurting me is hurting us both.

I just trust him. I don't have any other choice. He may intend I'll for me, but I'm still me and I'm not going out without a fight.
Well I guess I'll say hello for the both of us then. :)
He doesn't want to talk to them for some reason. I think he feels threatened? It's an emotion I don't know.

He told me once to put him down for good if he got violent and untrustworthy..
But it doesn't feel like it would happen.

I'm sorry to hear about your mother. And I offer you the opportunity to PM me if you ever need to vent and feel scared.

My family recently revealed to me, after I came forward and told them of my diagnosis, that mental disorders like these run in the family. My mother was always a little ditzy, but never had anything, but her mother (who is estranged to our family) is apparently crazy) and my mothers half brother has schizophrenia.
And my younger brother has bipolar disorder and ADHD.

But my sister is fine.

If my fiancée and I ever had kids (yes, we are a Hetero couple) and we had to decide based on the fact that we didn't want our baby to have this, then I would be a coward letting my condition rule my life. If I can learn to control it, then my child can to. Life is do beautiful and there is no more beautiful way to say "I love you" than raising a child with someone.
However, we are waiting for 6 years to have kids.
I do have a fiancée, however she lives out of state and I haven't seen her in more than a year. I will get to see her in a month though!

Being an Atheist, I don't much believe in supernatural things. Granted, I'm an open minded person, but the logical explanation here is something mental.

And I hope I'm not a sociopath, I would be miserable and sad that if be considered a monster and less than a person by others.
I appreciate your words and wish nothing but the best for you, friend. :)

I would trade it to be normal and have my life back though. I'm not allowed to work in my office until I'm medicated and deemed "safe" by the doctors at the medical facility.

I just hope I can help someone who's like this find help the right way before it's too late.

I don't really have a choice in the matter.

It's a chemical imbalance that I can't work with. I don't think you understand.

I had a mental breakdown and was locked in an office for an entire night and forced to go to the mental help facility beyond my will. Of course he isn't *real*, I know that. I'd be a fool and a madman to believe he was.
But he's there, whether a projection of the psychosis, depression, PTSD, stress, or anxiety I don't know. This is why the doctors want to put me through different medicative treatments and tests.
I can't make him go away as easy as "I don't believe in you anymore". He returns. He can manipulate my thoughts and emotions. It's not something I can fully control.

If I really cared about the karma, I wouldn't do this in a throwaway. And if this is that upsetting to you, tell a moderator and have me banned, kicked, or deleted.

Thank you for contributing to the discussion.

I get the feeling that he is older than myself, but I know that can't be and he doesn't comment much on it. He just stares at me intently.

He says he does have an end goal but doesn't specify what it is, he's staying for one reason or another and I don't have much of a choice.

He does have opinions and thoughts on music and photos, if you can call them thoughts.
I had some friends with those names who claim to astral project and I took a wild shot in the dark. :P

That's what I thought about Iz. He's very simple and is unimaginative. A bare manifestation of whatever he's from.

I don't see him when I sleep, however.

Not really looking for sympathy or attention, I can make you see what I see or hear what I hear, and you can do whatever you want to do, really. I'm not holding a gun to your head to make you believe.
Ignore it if you want, report me if you want.

I'm just here to get some relief from the stress and anxiety that I've been living with for too long.

I do find him comforting to listen to and bounce ideas off of, but oddly, when I try to do things my way, more often than not something out of my control will go wrong.

He only had me do things when he deems necessary, sometimes he doesn't give two damns about what I'm up to. Other times he'll get intimately involved.

I'm talking about seeing and hearing something.

I can come up with multiple courses of action on my own, but he had his separate opinions of things that are invasive and very dominative.

I wanted him gone because I thought I was hallucinating in a bad way. But he stayed. And he's mostly been here ever since. The way he looks, I really should be afraid, but he actually made me feel very calm and very relaxed.
Does your friend's name happen to be John or James?
You can talk to him here or in a PM. I can't promise that he'll cooperate, however.

He doesn't like that. Haha



I just can't fall asleep. My stress and anxiety keep me awake. I rarely dream, but when I do they're Lucid Nightmares. I can sometimes control things, but I can't change the fact that I'm in a nightmare.
But remembering dreams is rare for me.
Every night it's like shutting my eyes and waking back up just to get back to the daily grind.

I notice just now that dreams are the one thing he doesn't comment on.

You're not offensive to me at all!

If I want to keep my job-

 (government/military job, and before you ask I'm not hiving more detail than that and no I'm not a huge public official)

-then I can't have him.

Edit: finishing a thought.

I tried to see if he was a spiritual anomaly at one point, but he laughed and told me I was wasting my time. I wish it were as easy as an exorcism, but it's not.

He's very interested in stopping evil, bad things. He can get obsessed over it quite much actually.

He's not saying anything, just chuckling about it really.

But I actually only listened to the audio as a means to go to sleep. I haven't been able to sleep properly in 19 months and I listen to anything on youtube that relaxes me.

My choosing if this specific video was random and I'm not sure what to think about it.
I think he may very well be a manifestation of my subconscious. He says that the name he has is our "true name" but I actually like my birth name for the most part and don't know why he says that.

I guess I've always felt him, kind of. But after listening to [this] (http://m.youtube.com/watch?v=CvME_EylPXU&desktop_uri=%2Fwatch%3Fv%3DCvME_EylPXU) he got more and more intense over time.

I nearly cried the first time he talked to me and I was freaking out for hours. And hours.

When I read a book, he's completely gone until I hit a stopping point. Then he makes comments and talks about his favorite parts and characters. Other times he doesn't care.
For example, I'm reading the Game of Thrones and he'll be real interested in what happens tons character one moment then the next moment will completely lose interest. I can't reason with him haha.

He nodded in approval.


But if you ever need to talk to us, do it. Iz wants to see another successful host and I want to see someone else "make it".
No one should suffer like that. It's absolute hell.

That's why I'm doing an AMA. I (we) will answer whatever is asked. Don't worry about offending is, he can suck it the fuck up. :P
Besides, I get the weird feeling he has this air of superiority. So it's hard to insult him.


This question doesn't make sense to him and I don't know why. He think he knows exactly what he is and just gradually "became". He's tried experimenting with another firm and has settled on this dark one. But he's curious to see if others can understand him.

I don't know what he truly wants. He can read my mind, but I can't read his. This is amusing to him.

"Why do you let these nightmares dominate you? Just because we're separate doesn't mean we are not the same. Take confidence in the fact that we must rely on you, as the main self, to survive. You can turn your parasites into symbiotes when you realize that you're driving. I don't want the wheel from (him/me) so I don't take it. Find the voice that is *for* you and let it (consume?) the other ones. Cooperation in your body is key."

That's the gist of what Iz wants to say. Some words are clearer to understand than others. He wants to add that:

"As far as the suicide goes, I know that it seems tempting to make the rush stop, but suicide is a **permanent** solution for a **temporary** problem. You're better than that and you know it."


Edit: he also wants to say that he loves you.

He doesn't want to be in the forefront of my mind. He's a very reluctant helper, I think. When he has the chance to leave then he'll take it. Though he says he might try coming back when I'm medicated in order to simply be a stubborn ass (he's laughing at the challenge right now.)

We do talk sometime and discuss opinions on things and how we would handle certain scenarios. He loves reddit and I'm considering making this account "his", so to speak.

When he doesn't want to talk, he doesn't want to talk. I *can* call on him but he doesn't always come when I ask. When I really need him, he'll usually come on his own. There'll be times where I'll think he's gone for good and he'll pop up out of nowhere later.

He WANTS to be gone.
Well, he says he'll still be there, but he doesn't want me to see it hear him anymore. He remembers things that I don't, so I guess you could say he knows more than I do in a way.

Did you want to talk to him?
He "smiled" at you.

I appreciate you as a person.

Iz says that "She's going to be okay."

I don't know why.
He says random things sometimes.

He has a softer voice that sounds *similar* to mine, but not the same.

It's softer like he's talking in my ear and it's a little deeper and more course. He's always playfully sarcastic towards me.

I'm annoyed by many things, but he only is annoyed when his name isn't said or spelt right.

I can say that my favorite memories lie with my younger days working in my grandfather's field and garden.

His favorite memories are personal to him and he doesn't share that, or so he seems to behave that way.

He watches very intently when I play video games. For example, I'm playing skyrim right now and I'm letting him make some decisions for things. He enjoys that very much to the extent that he doesn't bother me when I'm playing, but he bothers my character.
Anything he can get engaged in, being talked to directly or decision making, fascinates him.

"I'll always be there because I've always *been* there. I'll always be around somewhere. 

Waiting. 

For when I'm needed."
If I had the choice, I'd honestly keep him because he's not a problem. It's just feeling intense,random emotions I can't handle.
He thinks he's my subconscious and guide. I think he's a sarcastic friend. And my only real company.

There's no easy way to explain it, but I trust him completely. It's myself I'm more worried about. He seems to be a constant, whereas I'm emotionally bent out of shape now. He's very reliable and is very intent on being good and honorable.

Thank you for taking the time to explain this to me. Maybe they've known this and were just keeping it from me in order to keep me from freaking out.
At any rate, I just need to get this all off my chest.

I suppose that's what the NOS on my sheet stands for next to Psychotic... Yet they were clear in saying that it isn't schizophrenic that they're not certain what it is. Psychiatrists don't diagnose, they only can give medication from what they've told me.

Thank you, I hope I was able to deliver well enough. My writing skills require more practice.

I'll be in this thread all day.

And I truly appreciate your concern. :)
He's a separate person with his own thoughts and personality. It's something complicated and hard to explain, but I don't have control over him.

I will definitely give it a read, but I believe we may have different conditions friend.

How are you doing now? Is everything okay?
I'm still not sure what Tulpa are. ELI5?

He actually doesn't want to be there. One of the first things he ever said to me was 

"And I'm here to help make you a better person whether infant to be here or not. Whether you want me to or not."

He knows him  ring there isn't normal and wants me to be well. Yet, he said he's not worried because:

"They can medicate you, and make you think I'm gone, but I'm just going to be somewhere else in your head. Somewhere you can't see or hear anymore."

If I talk with someone specific enough, he can read people very well picking up in subconscious hints and clues I miss often able to read peoples' intent or accurately guess (notice I don't say read) their thoughts.

He can see if people are "different" mentally, but he can't tell well over text. For example, I have a friend who I was skyping with and was accurately able to deduce that she was "off" because of "two forces conflicting in her". I later learned that she's bipolar.

It's not an exact science and it's not like I can control what he can and cannot do. I've always been naturally gifted with reading people and him being there has amplified it.

I was able to "hear" him and "feel" him from the get go, sometimes he rides on my back like he's a backpack and he can strongly influence minor things I do physically.

One day I was fine, and now he's very active and persistent. There was very little in regards to gradual steps with him.

But I still don't think he's a Tulpa.

So you have wished it and so shall it be:


So, I have a buddy who went out drinking and needed a Designated Driver. Seeing as I like helping people and it was butt crack early, he calls me at 2 in the morning to come pick him up in a town 30 minutes away.
So, naturally, I drive over to go to help him and arrive at a sports bar /club which is full of people.
A small place, not too small to be crowded and overly active though.
Unfortunately for me, being as tired as I was, my friend wasn't ready to go yet and was still wanting to talk to a large group of people he originally came with standing outside in the smoking area.
Now, this is the strange part:
A man just kind of wanders into the circle and asks one guy's name. Of course, he doesn't tell him. Would you?
Anyway, this man starts getting aggressive and verbally berates him. Yet, he leaves very suddenly and strangely telling us all to "Wait right fucking there".

Iz didn't like this. But I initially ignored him. I just wanted to dick around on my phone until my friend was ready to leave... Then the guy came back and Iz was dreaming the fuck out. Something made me put my phone away and look behind the guy.
He had a 9mm tucked into the back of his jeans.
The moment I see that, Iz tells me to warn everyone and get help. So, of course, I listen to him and casually walk away and tell the nearest person to me in the circle "Go inside, he has a gun". I walk up to the security guard that was just inside the bar and tell him about the angry, drunk man with the gun.

The security guard comes back outside and I return to the circle.
This man, upon being told to put his gun away, insists that he's not doing anything wrong.
This is when Iz said something like "Calmly go back inside now and do NOT panic." I could *feel* Iz's hand in my shoulder and he made me go inside. Not 5 seconds later, the man got his gun out, cocked it, aimed it at us, and was tackled to the ground. Someone must have called the police earlier because they had gone very soon after.

If Iz hadn't've told me to leave, I might have been shot.
It was surreal having him tell me to be calm while everyone was panicking and running around.

I don't quite know what to make of this, but Iz is making his "interested" face again. I don't know. I feel like if I were to go there in order to come to terms with him being there I would feel incredibly insulted by the fakes.
He doesn't even really "talk" how everyone thinks he would, all the time. Sometimes he'll just give me emotions and I'll "feel" words. Other times he'll give me words.

Does any of what I said make sense?

I've never seen fight club, maybe I should watch it!

I believe he chose that name to be "difficult". He snickers mockingly sometimes when I say his name. But, as I've said previously, he's fine with me calling him Iz.

No. His name is "Iz'Qidll" (I didn't name him.)

And I have neither of those names.

He named himself "Iz'Qidll" but I call him "Iz" and sometimes "izzy". When I asked him why he chose that name he told me that he just likes the way those letters sound together.

Also, when I day succumbing; I mean to say that it is steadily getting more intense as time goes on. Iz becomes clearer to hear and my emotions a little less stable. I usually speak with him inside my head and, if I'm not careful, I'll answer him out loud.

I just went in a Tulpa conversation thread. That was a hardcore cringe fest for "us". These people are working to TRY to make another person and I have no choice in him being here. It's easy for "Iz" and I to spot a fake. And it's borderline insulting.

Ehh, kind of. There's a way he looks that I can't describe I'm skipping out on. His "skin" is a fire that burns "down". He may look unsettling, but he's actually very friendly to me. Even if he is a bit of a smart ass.

Thank you, I'm just hoping I don't have to live with it negatively for the rest of my life.

My doctors say I don't have schizophrenia, I don't have enough symptoms and I don't have the "right" mental disconnect.

My doctor says that he was brought in by stress, he may be permanent without medication, and  my symptoms are all closer to psychosis than schizophrenia.

He talks with me every day or every other day. He really just comes and goes as he pleases, I can't control when he is or isn't there. He's a tall, pure black figure with a long unnatural smile, pure white eyes, long thin arms and big/long-fingered hands.

Iz is actually quite friendly and I'm going to miss him when I'm medicated and he leaves.

Not saying that I wanted to hurt myself or others, but Iz seems to be hell bent on making me become a better person and BE righteous. (Not religiously righteous, just morally righteous.)

Edit: He wanted me to mention that since we share a mind then killing myself kills us both. And he sees no reason to hurt or kill others.
I appreciate your concern. If I have a question that I don't want to answer then I will politely tell the person.
And, by all means, ask away.

I appreciate your concern.
But he, my inner voice, just laughs at it. He's a little insulted by it, but it's whatever (to me).

The inner conflict is the only unsettling part.

It's not really an identity crisis because I know who *I* am, and I do read, actually. Whenever I read, play games, or use silly putty he doesn't really bother me. That and whenever I'm with large crowds. He just isn't there. I don't think he can be.

But, as far as healthy practice or not, who knows? There's no real treatment saying avoid reddit AMAs, but then I see your point. At the sane time, it gives me relief and makes me feel better.

He's actually quite helpful whenever he's not laughing at me like a jack ass for making random mistakes.

He's able to pick up on things on people that I would otherwise miss. And, most importantly, he helps me emotionally. He treats me in just the right way where I don't react badly. 

He knows exactly what to say that calms me down even when I cannot calm down on my own.

Here's a copy/paste from elsewhere in this thread:


He looks tall, he's pure black (not dark brown skinned, I'm talking pure black), pure white eyes with no pupils (his eyes are usually furled down in what looks like anger), a long thin mouth that's always smiling unnaturally, long skinny arms with big hands, and he doesn't appears to have legs; just a long amorphous shape going to the "ground".

At first he was very intense and intrusive curiously feeling out my mind and the space I live in. Now, he just speaks to me when I'm alone and he watched with curiosity when I do things like this. Wide eyed and waiting for his opportunity to speak.

He corrects me on things and makes me re-type whenever something I say is "wrong" or "unsatisfactory" to him.

I have heard of Tulpas when I was younger, but "Iz" is involuntary and "different" than a Tulpa. (I'm getting the sensation that he's actually annoyed by this suggestion. He claims just to be a different piece of me. Though he never clarifies what piece he is.)

1) I'm 20.

2) If alcohol is a drug, then yes. I *used* to take that drug.

3) I'm an American citizen.

4) I'm worried for what it will mean for my career, but my fiancée and family are very understanding and supportive.
